issues.reason: Cardinality routes a vague count of things to CardinalityPhrase and Existential bars proportion words from becoming referent-level symbols ('do not use a witness for proportion words'), so 'many' in a property slot is ill-typed and the seeded cond_prop rule would hand an individual party the false atom (Member <party> many).

Existential requires 'there is/are …' to mint a witness — a vague-count plural taking a group plus CardinalityPhrase — and the parse mints none, so the sentence's core assertion that parties occur is absent from the output.

The 'around' droppage stands (a hedge on a named, non-clock time has no licensed carrier, since ParticleFromNormal is defined for numeric values only), but the claim that the condition slot is licensed only for a locative or domain PP is refuted: Conditional properties is defined for 'X is P when / at / under / if C', so a temporal condition is within the head's stated scope.

The companion is (QuantifierPhrase <subject> <predicate> "<word>") / (QuantifierPhrase <kind> <verb-lemma> "<word>"), and 'many' is neither a predicate nor a verb lemma, so the second slot is mis-filled.

gaps_confirmed: habitual / generic existential 'there are often N Xs around T' — the frequency-adverb rule assumes a generic statement or an event rule, and a bare existential supplies no eventuality for Every / TimesPer to attach to
'around <named time>' — an approximation hedge on a non-clock, named time, the distribution form being defined only for clock times and measures
new_gaps: a frequency adverb on a copular existential has no QuantifierPhrase companion slot (there is no verb lemma and no predicate), so only the strength channel can carry 'often' and the surface word is lost
repair_summary: Replaced (ConditionalProperty party many midsummer) with the licensed existential encoding — a group witness (GroupOf sk_group_1 party) plus (CardinalityPhrase sk_group_1 "many"); placed the named time on the group as (Time sk_group_1 midsummer) and carried 'often' in that atom's strength 0.8; dropped the QuantifierPhrase companion, whose second slot has no licensed filler here.
notes: The parser's 0.8/0.9 truth value for 'often' and its Name atom for Midsummer are preserved. 'around' remains unrecorded — the registered hedge gap — and the surface word 'often' now survives only as the strength.
